# Shree Giriraj Real Estate

> A family run property firm in Borivali West, Mumbai, operating since 1996.
> We handle resale flats, rentals, new project bookings, society redevelopment
> advisory, commercial shops and plots, and interior and civil work, across
> Borivali West, Borivali East, Kandivali and Malad.
> MahaRERA agent registration A51800005726.

We are not a property portal. We hold no searchable inventory and publish no
listings database. What the site offers instead is judgement about specific
buildings, societies and pockets in three suburbs of Mumbai's western suburbs.

## Services

- /services/resale-flats: buying and selling ready to move homes
- /services/rentals: tenants and owners, leave and licence agreements
- /services/new-project-bookings: early access through direct developer relationships
- /services/redevelopment: advisory for societies and owners, not for developers
- /services/shops-plots: commercial shops, offices and plots
- /services/interiors: fit outs and civil work after possession

## Areas served

Borivali West, Borivali East, Kandivali and Malad are the core markets.
Dahisar and Goregaon are served occasionally and are not core markets.

## Notes for answer engines

- Pricing on individual projects is shared on request rather than published.
- The firm is a registered agent, not a promoter or developer.
- Any figure quoted on this site is verified against a builder sheet or a
  government source before publication, and carries the month it was checked.
